title: TOP 10 AI USE CASES: Jimmy and Matt recommend their favourite practical uses for LLM's
description: Send us Fan Mail Ever wondered how AI could transform your everyday life, from your kitchen to your workspace? Discover how AI models like Claude can revolutionize your culinary adventures, turning meal planning and recipe management into a breeze by personalizing suggestions based on what you have at home and your dietary preferences. We'll share surprising tips on how these AI tools can streamline your cooking experience, making it as enjoyable and hassle-free as possible. Coding doesn't have to be intimidating, especially for beginners. Learn from personal experiences as we discuss using ChatGPT and Claude to master RStudio and enhance your data analysis skills. By crafting clear, detailed prompts, these AI models not only generate helpful code but also aid in understanding it, boosting your proficiency in tasks like creating Excel pivot tables. Explore the role of AI in design and productivity, providing innovative solutions for everything from room layouts to productivity tools that could redefine your workflow. Thinking about AI's creative potential? We' dive into AI-generated content, be it images, songs, or conversations that feel just like a counseling session. Discover how to ensure your privacy with offline tools, verify AI-generated information, and stay informed about the rapidly changing AI landscape. With insights and stories about AI's role in areas like health recommendations, design, and beyond, this episode promises to keep you informed and inspired while highlighting the importance of critical thinking in this AI-driven world. http://cerebras.vercel.app/ https://workspace.google.com/intl/en_uk/ http://suno.com/ https://github.com/features/copilot#pricing https://claude.ai
summary: Answering listener feedback that the show had gone too deep into doom, Jimmy and Matt run through their ten favourite practical LLM use cases, from meal planning and no-code Excel scripting to custom supplement schedules, voice chats and Suno songwriting. It doubles as a hands-on tutorial, with prompts, free-tier advice and candid notes on where the tools still fail.
keyTalkingPoints: Meal planning with Claude beats ad-filled recipe sites — it scales servings, substitutes ingredients and even generates shopping lists in artifacts
Non-coders can get working VBA/Excel scripts by pasting data in and describing the output, turning LLMs into a genuine learning tool
Matt's most-used use case is a custom health routine: Claude rates his supplements, flags clashes and adjusts for exercise days
Matt describes talking through a personal issue with Claude as a genuinely life-changing conversation, though both hosts stress it is not counselling
NotebookLM-style summarization into text, slide decks or audio will soon extend to AI-character video summaries

jimmy: Free tiers of GPT and Claude are still enough for most everyday use cases
Suno song generation for the podcast is the most fun he has had with AI
Photorealistic image generation is already at the level where it can deceive people — a warning sign for video
The best preparation for AI is to actually use it, and fact-check it while doing so
matt: Coding with an LLM is as much a learning method as a productivity hack — you can ask it to explain every step
LLMs checking other LLMs is one of the best use cases, especially for non-experts
Custom lifestyle and health planning with Claude is his personal number-one use
Summarization into exactly the format you absorb best (audio, slides, even a haiku) is near-universally useful
